reviewed_context_transfers.basis: Native instruction bodies match the reviewed same-release Lua context boundaries byte for byte through their transfer instruction.

reviewed_value_contracts.reason: Recover native value returns and full precision arguments before propagating them to callers.

reviewed_pic_state_anchors.basis: Immutable native PC constants and their immutable scalar aliases plus constant offsets resolving into module data.

reviewed_inline_dispatch_tables.basis: Native PC-relative signed offsets terminating at the first word that cannot resolve to module text.

reviewed_virtual_owner_calls.basis: Deleting destructor slot and reference-count guarded control-block release preserve the native owner argument.

reviewed_lexer_pic_base.basis: Native PIC references retain the original PC even when the decompiler reuses its spill name for later lexer temporaries.

reviewed_callback_invocation.basis: Native indirect callback receives aggregate output, holder, VM owner and argument vector in four stack words. Source internal callbacks use explicit output pointers; cleanup must reference the actual local argument vector rather than a decompiler stack-purge alias.

reviewed_x87_exponential_argument: Native expl loads a ten-byte argument from a twelve-byte i386 stack slot and returns through the full ST0 register.

reviewed_decimal_integer_conversion.basis: Native x87 FILD loads the signed 64-bit integral decimal component numerically before adding the fractional digits.
